chunks: (Fear) Allāh (and) keep Allāh in view in the matter of jihād with the help of your property, lives and tongues in the way of Allāh.

key_terms.جِهَاد: Striving or exertion in the path of God

ai.seo_question: What are the three means of jihad mentioned in Imam Ali's will?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) structures this tripartite jihad to encompass the complete spectrum of human effort, reflecting the Shia understanding that spiritual struggle extends beyond physical combat to include financial sacrifice and eloquent da'wah. This comprehensive approach underscores the holistic nature of devotion in the Ahl al-Bayt tradition, where every aspect of life becomes a means of drawing closer to God.
